U.note: Striking retro LCD calculator with solid logic and keyboard/aria support, but at 18KB it is heavier than basic and the faint ghost segments plus tiny hint text cost some clarity.

V.note: Warm, clean and legible with an expression line, a clear divide-by-zero message, comma grouping and good aria and keyboard support, all in a moderate amount of code.

W.note: Compact iOS-style dark calculator that gets the arithmetic right, but it has minimal accessibility, a low-contrast operator column and a plain, cramped look.

X.note: Clean light design with a clear error state, an expression line and good aria support, though the pale operator keys are subtle.

Y.note: Generic iOS clone that works, but it has almost no aria, a bare Error with no explanation, a dead-code branch and every operator key in the same orange.

Z.note: Polished dark glass look with a full-width equals key and good aria and keyboard support, though the decorative glow and the hint line pad it slightly past basic.
